root_cause.text: The function `amdgpu_userq_get_doorbell_index()` does not validate that the user-supplied `doorbell_offset` is within the allocated doorbell buffer object (BO) before passing it to `amdgpu_doorbell_index_on_bar()`, allowing an arbitrarily large offset to cause out-of-bounds access that can corrupt kernel doorbell space.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a bounds check using `(u64)db_info->doorbell_offset * db_size + db_size > amdgpu_bo_size(db_obj->obj)`, and the CVE/commit description explicitly states "An arbitrarily large doorbell_offset can cause the calculated doorbell index to fall outside the allocated doorbell BO, potentially corrupting kernel doorbell space."
